text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hm! Hm-hm-hmmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Happy New Year! ♪
choice_data_list: You seem to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I was just at a party celebrating
the
completion of our year-end
concert...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm not drunk at all! This gal is raring to
go! We
should totally hit up a round of
karaoke! ♪
choice_data_list: And that's what made you motion sick?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Come ooon! I just went to a New Year's

countdown concert! I wanna sing!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: What are we waiting for?! Go, go, go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's sing a duet! Ooh, and the new
year's
food menu looks good! ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Now, now! It's a new year—let's live a
little! No?
choice_data_list: Wouldn't it be better if we just went home...?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ♪ All right, let's start off with this
classic!
choice_data_list: Let's eat and take a breather!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Umapyoi! Umapyoi!
Oooh,
sukidacchi! ☆

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... wheeze... I can't believe... just one song... took so much out of me...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Um, thank you for coming with me,
Trainer. Or,
well...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: S-sorry for causing you so much trouble!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was pretty concerned, but it's a relief
to see that
she's sobered up.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Then, let's go all out with this fancy New
Year's
platter! There's enough spiny
lobster, crab, and
roast beef for five
people! ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew... That was delicious. I'm stuffed...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And my eyelids are starting to... feel
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Thanks for taking me home,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Ehehe, my first dream of the year will be great... I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello calls me the next day and
apologizes
profusely for her antics.
